clause: The Tenant shall not undertake, or permit his/her family or guests to undertake, any hazardous acts or do anything that will increase the project's insurance premiums. Such action constitutes a material non-compliance.
label: concerning
reason: The trigger is vague, anything that raises insurance costs, and the consequence is serious enough to end the tenancy.

clause: Whenever damage is caused by carelessness, misuse, or neglect on the part of the Tenant, his/her family or visitors, the Tenant agrees to pay rent for the period the unit is damaged whether or not the unit is habitable.
label: concerning
reason: You keep paying full rent for a place you cannot live in, which most people would not expect.

clause: If any of the following changes occur, the Tenant agrees to advise the Landlord immediately...If the Tenant does not advise the Landlord of these interim changes, the Landlord may increase the Tenant's rent to the HUD-approved market rent.
label: concerning
reason: Missing a paperwork deadline, rather than breaking any rule of the tenancy, can push your rent up to full market rate.

clause: If any Court declares a particular provision of this Agreement to be invalid or illegal, all other terms of this Agreement will remain in effect and both the Landlord and the Tenant will continue to be bound by them.
label: neutral
reason: Standard severability wording found in almost every contract, not a burden specific to this one.

clause: The Tenant agrees not to: sublet or assign the unit, or any part of the unit; use the unit for unlawful purposes.
label: neutral
reason: Standard restrictions on subletting and illegal use, expected in nearly every lease.

clause: The Tenant agrees not to install additional or different locks or gates on any doors or windows of the unit without the written permission of the Landlord. When this Agreement ends, the Tenant agrees to return all keys to the dwelling unit to the Landlord. The Landlord may charge the Tenant a fee for each key not returned.
label: neutral
reason: Normal lock and key terms, sounds restrictive but is common practice.

clause: The Landlord may not terminate this Agreement for failure to pay late charges, but may terminate this Agreement for non-payment of rent.
label: favorable
reason: Protects the tenant from losing the home over a late fee, which not every lease spells out.

clause: If the unit is damaged by fire, wind, or rain to the extent that the unit cannot be lived in and the damage is not caused or made worse by the Tenant, the Tenant will be responsible for rent only up to the date of the destruction. Additional rent will not accrue until the unit has been repaired to a livable condition.
label: favorable
reason: Rent stops when the place is unlivable through no fault of the tenant, which is better than many leases offer.

clause: Landlord agrees to allow tenant and tenant organizers to conduct on the property the activities related to the establishment or operation of a tenant organization set out in accordance with HUD requirements.
label: favorable
reason: Explicit right to organize with other tenants, a protection most leases do not mention.
